tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// byur bsal ba bzhugs// ༄༅// de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i phyir/ skyes pa'am bud med gdugs gcig smyung bar bgyis pa/ rab tu bkrus pa shin tu brgyan pa des/ dog sa la me tog gi sil ma bkram ste/ spos sna tshogs kyis bdug la/ seng ldeng dang*/ rgya shug rigs gnyis kyi zhugs bus la/ sa bon thams cad phyogs bzhir gtor bar bgyi/ zhugs kyi nang du yang gtor bar bgyi/ rtsa ba thams cad dang*/ me tog thams cad tshon skud sna tshogs la brgyus te/ ral gri'am/ mdung rtse gsum pa'am/ mdung ngam mda' la gdags par bgyi'o// spos chab sna tshogs sbyar te/ bum pa chen po'i nang du blugs la gang la byad kyis phog pa de skud pa des bcings te/ bum pa'i chab kyis bkru bar bgyi'o// skud pa yang mtshon gyis bcad de/ zhugs kyi nang du dor ro// stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i gzungs 'di yang brjod par bya'o// gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs dbang dang ni 'jig rten skyong*// gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug dang*// de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*// de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyi// che ge mo yi byad stems las// rnam pa thams cad chad gyur cig /ces brjod cing bcings pa'i tshon skud rnams bcad par bya'o// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mes sreg cing*/ rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang*// me yis bud shing sreg pa dang*// rlung gis sprin rnams gtor ba dang*// nyi mas nags tshal skems byed pa// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// byad stems las rnams tshig gyur cig /spos dang me tog sna tshogs kyis// sdig pa thams cad nges par bsal// tadya thā/ hu me hu me/ ka kha li/ ka kha li/ kha ra le/ dzu hwi ni/ dza ba le/ ga ra ge ha ra ge ha ra gi shā ba ri/ shānta/ pra shānti swā hā/

dhā ba ni swā hā/ pra dhā ba ni swā hā/ gandharbhā swā hā/ pa lam̐ gi ni swā hā/ sarba kā kho rda/ tstshe da ni swā hā/ i mairyant+ra sa der/ ma ma sarba sa tā nañtsa/ sarba kā khorda/ be da do ṣa ti/ mant+ra bi ṣa pra yo ga sarba da rbai shtshe di tra/ be di tā dzi ta pa ra dzi ta swā hā/ zhes bsreg pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa byas nas thal ba lam gyi bzhi mdor dor ro// byur bsal ba ste brgyad pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
